seo.title: Best Lakeside Hotel in Udaipur | The Udaisarovar – Resort & Cottages from ₹4,500
seo.description: The Udaisarovar is a private lakeside resort on Udai Sagar, Udaipur: lake-view cottages from ₹4,500 with breakfast, an infinity pool, bonfire camping, home-style food and full-property buyouts. Book direct.

hero.title: A private retreat on the shores of
hero.subtitle: Five cottages, an infinity pool that meets the lake and wide lawns, about twenty minutes from the City of Lakes.

welcome.label: Welcome to The Udaisarovar
welcome.title: Where the lake is your only neighbour
welcome.text: A boutique resort right at the water's edge of Udai Sagar. Just five bedrooms, an infinity pool that melts into the lake, sunrise over the Aravallis and evenings by the bonfire. Made for couples, families, small groups and celebrations.

stay.title: Four elemental cottages and a family suite
stay.text: Air, Water, Earth and Fire: each cottage faces the lake or the pool, with breakfast by the water included in every stay.

dining.label: Lake City Café
dining.title: Home-style vegetarian, served by the water
dining.text: Fresh paneer, slow-cooked dals, hot chapatis and seasonal vegetables. Breakfast on the lawn, candle-lit dinners at the lake's edge and live BBQ nights.

events.label: Weddings & Events
events.title: Celebrate on the shores of the lake
events.text: A 21,556 sq ft lawn with three settings, the garden, the lakefront shore and the poolside deck, for weddings, Holi, New Year's Eve and private parties of 400 to 600 guests.
events.price_line: Take the whole resort from ₹1,20,000 a day.
